text:
vik: heads-up — onboarding albatross-v2-int8 produced a spike in structured-output schema rejects for funcalls. validator complains about "numeric_type_mismatch" even though payload looks fine at glance.

yana: any example?

vik: uploaded some traces to s3://canary/albatross/1767777777. one payload: ```{"action":"update_count","count":1e+02}``` our schema expects an integer (count: int). strict schema validator rejects scientific notation tokens as type mismatch.

omar: whoa. model emitted `1e+02` rather than `100`. fp16 baseline emits `100` as integer literal. quant tokenizer/kernel may have merged exponent pieces into a single token leading to `1e+02` token output.

ken: canary-bot: deploy albatross-v2-int8-canary @ 1767776000 -> hostset z1. recent: 80 successes / 6 schema_rejects in last 30m. failing ids: cnry-num-1767777788, cnry-num-1767777933.

yana: quick triage shows concentration on numeric-only fields and short outputs (<40 tokens). non-numeric fields unaffected. uploaded 18 raw samples.

marta: quick mitigation options: 1) sanitizer that normalizes numbers: parse JSON using tolerant numeric parser that accepts exponent forms and coerces to integer when within tolerance (e.g., float.is_integer after rounding) 2) reject/ retry: treat as parse-allowed but schema-fail triggers a single quick retry with same prompt, hoping model emits canonical integer form.

ovar: typo — omar: we should be careful: coercing could change semantics (e.g., count=1e+02 -> 100 safe, but count=1e-3 -> 0 would be a big change). must only coerce when magnitude and fractional parts make coercion lossless.

vik: proposed two-step rescue for canary routes: A) on schema reject due to numeric type, attempt numeric-normalize sanitizer that: - only targets fields declared integer in schema - accepts exponent notation and numeric strings - converts if abs(round(x) - x) < 1e-6 and x within 64-bit int range - tag telemetry `rescue=number_normalize` B) if sanitizer fails, issue single retry (telemetry `rescue=retry_numeric`) and mirror original+sanitized payloads.

ken: approve as opt-in for canary, but add strict guard: do not auto-execute sanitized actions without safety check. Instead: 1) if sanitized parse yields same action name and args except numerics normalized, allow execution but record `sanitized_exec=true` 2) otherwise fail and route to mirror. Also add a golden-check comparing effect on small test harness.

yana: ran a local batch: number_normalize rescued 13/18 failures. of those, 12 had exact integer equivalence (1e+02 -> 100). 1 was small (1e-3) and sanitizer correctly refused. good signal.

marta: long-term: quant/kernel should align numeric tokenization with canonical forms for structured outputs. file QNT-1150 to investigate token merge behavior for numeric tokens and exponent parts. also add a unit test in model-infra CI that fuzzes numbers and validates canonical emission for int/float fields.

omar: also add a lightweight eval: run golden-funcall correctness on 5k prompts comparing sanitized vs original for action semantics. if discrepancy >0.1% pause auto-rescue.

ken: alerting: add `number_normalize_rate` series and alert if >2% sustained for 30m. add histogram by field_name.

vik: action items: omar to prototype sanitizer + parser patch (PR today), yana to run 4h soft-canary with opt-in sanitizer and collect golden-check diffs, marta to open QNT-1150 and add CI fuzz test, ken to add alerts/dashboard. i'll coordinate mirror permissions and review diff logs.

omar: pushing prototype now. example tolerant parse snippet in PoC: ```python
raw = b'{"action":"update_count","count":1e+02}\n'
obj = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))
# walk schema fields, for int fields attempt coercion:
val = obj['count']
if isinstance(val, float) and abs(round(val)-val) < 1e-6:
    obj['count'] = int(round(val))
```

yana: note — we need robust parsing for values that come as strings: "count":"1e+02" should also be supported.

ken: good catch. implement safe coercion and mirror originals for auditing. if canary looks good after 24h, escalate to broader rollout with caution.

vik: thanks team — let's keep this feature-flagged until QNT-1150 lands. will post canary metrics tomorrow. :thumbsup:
